FileStorage follows a pre-existing directory and predictable key/temp paths without ownership, mode, file-type, or symlink checks; writes use create+truncate on \u003ckey\u003e.tmp. Another local user can precreate /tmp/lichen, inject id.seed/trust/replay files, read the generated identity, or place symlinks at predictable temp paths (particularly dangerous if lichend runs privileged for TUN). All simulator instances also collide on one identity/state namespace.
